intro:
The World of Japanese Fairy Tales
Simple Jumping and harsh Races
The appeal of simultaneous Japanese and English display
description:
A wild new "RABBIT AND TURTLE HARSH JUMP RACE" has begun!

Rabbits can move quickly, but they can only jump. On the other hand, turtles move slowly, but they take the safest and shortest route towards their goal. As a rabbit, can you skillfully jump over the various challenging and difficult courses and reach the finish line before the turtle?

There are all sorts of stages, from turtles pulling out strange machines to crows suddenly becoming allies, to races taking place during heavy snow with frozen platforms—it's a truly chaotic race!

While the simultaneous display of Japanese and English can be educational, it might be more suitable for mental training.
